scope: Live compositional intent-hypothesis generation from relevant Human/Sequence parameter signals, relation/order structure and prior closed intent signatures.
validated_behaviors: Generates new intent candidates even when the utterance contains no explicit intent/motive words.
Composes intent signatures from GOAL/TARGET/METHOD/CONDITION/ORDER/MODIFIER/CONSTRAINT/STATE atoms rather than selecting one fixed character label.
Recognizes same intent signature in supplied closed history as SUPPORT_PRIOR_INTENT.
A newly plugged relevant approved Human parameter can change the generated intent signature space.
Generated intent remains HYPOTHESIZED and review-required with proof debt, falsifiers and alternatives.
No live intent candidate receives direct action authority.
not_closed: Intent hypotheses are not actor-intent facts.
The system does not yet auto-activate all 3,204 Human parameters from raw language at atomic precision.
Semantic parameter-to-intent role coverage must grow as more approved/candidate parameters are plugged.
Persistence/UI for intent review and versioned intent-pattern writeback remains open.
next: P2-LIVE-PARAMETER-ACTIVATION-TO-INTENT-002: deepen atomic Human parameter activation and role binding so newly plugged/activated parameters automatically expand live pattern and intent generation; then persist these objects through Rubric Microscope storage.
